sessionShellHygiene.scope: Five harness background shells (baseline gate, camera gate, remaining gates, final seal gate, isolated vite preview on 4183) plus three foreground gate batches. The preview ran on 4183 because port 4173 is held by a node process from outside this repo, which was never assumed to serve this build; it was stopped at closeout and 4183 and 53173 were re-checked with zero listeners. Non-yielded foreground commands are not counted as background shells.

lastSessionSummary: Session 165 ran a full recovery-checked arc: triaged and recovered the Session 164 write-back debt (fifteen commits shipped and deployed after S163 sealed, with no closeout for 96.8h), then shipped a scrolling world camera, a sixteen-bot 2x-arena BOT ROYALE, a fix for royale bots that had been targeting themselves since the mode shipped, camera-correct threat compass / floating text / whole-arena radar, and a death-beat diet moving the share-card painter, QR encoder and on-screen keyboard off the DeathScreen chunk (101.8 KB to 90.5 KB). Root-fixed two studio gates that were silently red on main without lowering either budget.
